column1: You look at the floor and see what appears to be a substantial amount of blood.
column2: 你查看地板，發現大量疑似血跡。

column1: It's a common type of motel nightstand, with a single drawer.
column2: 這是常見的汽車旅館床頭櫃，只有一個抽屜。

column1: There is a letter inside.
column2: 裡面有一封信。

column1: You don't have an envelope.
column2: 你沒有信封。

column1: What name? What address?
column2: 什麼名字？什麼地址？

column1: The letter is addressed to Woody Roberts.
column2: 這封信寄給伍迪．羅伯茲。

column1: Nothing special. Just a normal TV, chained to the wall.
column2: 沒什麼特別的。只是台用鏈條鎖在牆上的普通電視。

column1: Bains must have used this chair for the booby trap.....
column2: 班恩斯一定是用這張椅子設置陷阱的……

column1: You are in the bathroom
column2: 你在浴室裡。

column1: You find nothing inside the drawer.
column2: 抽屜裡什麼也沒有。

column1: You look inside the drawer ...
column2: 你查看抽屜內部……

column1: and you find an envelope with the corner torn off.
column2: 你找到一個角落被撕掉的信封。

column1: The drawer is closed...
column2: 抽屜是關著的……

column1: You are not close enough.
column2: 你離得還不夠近。

column1: There is a dark stain on the carpet.
column2: 地毯上有一塊深色污漬。

column1: Normal size shower... Nothing here.
column2: 普通大小的淋浴間……什麼也沒有。

column1: You look around the empty bathroom. You see typical bathroom fixtures: a sink, a toilet, a shower and a mirror.
column2: 你環視空蕩蕩的浴室，看見一般的衛浴設備：水槽、馬桶、淋浴間和鏡子。

column1: You see a dark stain on the carpet.
column2: 你看見地毯上有一塊深色污漬。

column1: There is no lipstick in this room.
column2: 這個房間裡沒有口紅。

column1: The label reads, Pink Rapture by Donna Lee Cosmetics. "This is the same brand that Marie uses," you think.
column2: 標籤寫著：Donna Lee 化妝品的 Pink Rapture。「這和瑪麗使用的是同一品牌，」你心想。

column1: You don't have time to watch TV now.
column2: 你現在沒時間看電視。

column1: You move it, look under it, but find nothing.
column2: 你把它移開，查看底下，卻什麼也沒找到。

column1: You'll need your field kit.
column2: 你需要現場勘查箱。

column1: You already did.
column2: 你已經做過了。

column1: Using the eyedropper, you take a sample of the blood from the floor and put it into a vial.
column2: 你用滴管採集地板上的血液樣本，放入小瓶中。
